Huma is supporting that shift with working rails for payment financing, built to the discipline institutional capital requires. They have been an excellent partner for Sentora, and we are glad to be building alongside them.” Anthony DeMartino CEO Sentora “Settlement financing is one of the oldest credit businesses in the world, and Huma is one of the first teams we’ve seen run it onchain properly. Huma built PST the way that RWA assets should be built: issued natively onchain instead of wrapping an offchain fund, backed by the receivables it finances, and short in duration. It’s been great to partner and work closely with the Huma team and we’re looking forward to build the onchain future together.” Hunter Horsley CEO Bitwise Asset Management “We’ve worked closely with Huma as an on-chain liquidity provider and vault curator, expanding access to its real-world payment flows. We’ve been impressed by the project’s execution and scaling PST. Huma’s growth shows that there is demand for on-chain finance from both sides: businesses seeking efficient capital and investors generating stable and uncorrelated yield.” Samantha Bohbot General Partner RockawayX “At TradeFlow Capital, we see stablecoins as essential infrastructure for making cross-border trade finance faster, more transparent and more efficient. Huma shares our belief that digital liquidity should generate sustainable real-world yield by financing genuine commercial activity. Together, we’re helping connect institutional capital with the businesses and supply chains that power the global economy.” Dr. Tom James CEO & CIO TradeFlow “Payments can only move as fast as liquidity allows. With an estimated $4 trillion in working capital tied up in prefunded accounts, eliminating this capital inefficiency is critical to building truly real-time payments. Through Huma’s infrastructure, which provides greater transparency for investors and enables more flexible capital, we’re tackling this bottleneck, delivering liquidity where and when it’s needed and helping eliminate the trade-off between speed and capital efficiency.” Ali Erhat Nalbant Co-founder & CEO Arf Sentora Bitwise RockawayX TradeFlow Arf Latest from our Blog Announcement Huma Built PayFi.
